sessions.phase_label: Initial concurrence scope and separate permit-package scoping
Waiting for client redlines and project confirmation
Concurrence method selection, delivery, and document corrections
Client comment callouts and follow-up stamping

requirements.title: Review and Concur with Electrical Modifications
requirements.definition: Review the minor electrical modifications documented in the Word file against the pre-project as-built information and provide discipline-specific engineering concurrence without redesign, panel upgrades, or unnecessary calculations.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the substantive engineering review and concurrence only. PE credential validity, application of the stamp/signature, and the presentation format of the concurrence package can fail or change independently.

requirements.title: Use Correct Nevada Electrical PE Credentials
requirements.definition: The engineer providing concurrence must be an appropriately licensed Nevada Electrical PE whose actual name and license information are correctly identified for the project.
requirements.boundary_note: Credential identity and jurisdictional eligibility are separate from whether a stamp and signature are physically present on the delivered artifact.

requirements.title: Apply PE Stamp and Signature
requirements.definition: Apply the required Electrical PE stamp and signature to the agreed concurrence artifact covering the electrical modifications.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the presence of the professional stamp and signature. The choice between a Word file, cover letter, redlined PDF, or drawing callouts belongs to the separate documentation-format Requirement.

requirements.title: Prepare the Accepted Concurrence Documentation
requirements.definition: Present the approved electrical changes in the client-accepted documentation form, including the Word-file and cover-letter method or requested drawing callouts, with correct identifying text and date formatting.
requirements.boundary_note: The Word file, cover letter, redlined PDF, and drawing callouts are alternative or revised presentations of one concurrence package. Engineer-name text and US date format are attributes of that package rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Address Client and City Comments
requirements.definition: Provide bounded follow-up revisions needed to address client or city comments about the concurrence method or presentation.
requirements.boundary_note: Represents the independently promised follow-up obligation, not a generic QA or debugging Requirement. Concrete requested document changes should still be routed to the affected documentation or stamping Requirement rather than duplicated here.

requirements.title: Create Additional-Project Mechanical Permit Drawings
requirements.definition: Create permit-ready mechanical drawings for the separately discussed prospective project.
requirements.boundary_note: Mechanical drafting is independently deliverable from plumbing and electrical drafting. Mechanical PE stamping by the client is excluded from this Requirement.

requirements.title: Create Additional-Project Plumbing Permit Drawings
requirements.definition: Create permit-ready plumbing drawings for the separately discussed prospective project.
requirements.boundary_note: Plumbing drafting is a separate discipline deliverable and should not be merged with mechanical or electrical drawing creation merely because all were discussed as one permit package.

requirements.title: Create Additional-Project Electrical Permit Drawings
requirements.definition: Create permit-ready electrical drawings for the separately discussed prospective project.
requirements.boundary_note: Electrical drawing creation is independently testable from electrical calculations and from applying a PE stamp to the completed drawings.

requirements.title: Perform Additional-Project Electrical Calculations
requirements.definition: Perform the electrical calculations required to produce the additional project's permit-ready electrical drawings.
requirements.boundary_note: Electrical calculations are separated from HVAC Manual J/S/D calculations because they serve different disciplines and can be changed or delivered independently.

requirements.title: Perform Additional-Project HVAC Calculations
requirements.definition: Perform applicable HVAC sizing and distribution calculations, including Manual J, Manual S, and Manual D, while excluding Title 24 calculations.
requirements.boundary_note: Manual J, S, and D are treated as attributes of one coupled HVAC calculation package rather than three separate Requirements. Electrical calculations remain separate.

requirements.title: Apply Electrical PE Stamp to Additional-Project Drawings
requirements.definition: Apply an Electrical PE stamp to the permit-ready electrical drawings for the separately discussed prospective project.

requirements.title: Use California Electrical PE Credentials for Additional Project
requirements.definition: Use an appropriately licensed California Electrical PE and provide the corresponding license information for the separately discussed permit project.

unresolved_candidates.description: The separately discussed permit package clearly includes electrical drawings, calculations, and an electrical PE stamp, but the wording is less clear on whether the freelancer would personally create both the mechanical and plumbing drawings. Those discipline Requirements are retained provisionally rather than merged.

The client explicitly reserved follow-up work for client or city comments, but it may ultimately function only as task-local scope for concrete documentation revisions rather than an independently replayable Requirement.
